name: กังนัมคลินิก สาขาฟิวเจอร์ พาร์ค รังสิต

summary_en: Gangnam Clinic at Future Park Rangsit specializes in facial skin care, maintaining a 4.9 rating from 2,057 total reviews and an 88.8 trust score. The clinic has been mentioned in 8 Pantip discussions, with one thread specifically referencing this branch.
